children: Target Hospitality priced a 14,000,000-share secondary offering at $18.50 per share and agreed a concurrent ~$30,000,000 stock repurchase.
Selling stockholders sold 14,000,000 shares at $18.50 per share; gross proceeds to sellers approx. $259,000,000.
Underwriters granted a 30-day option to buy up to an additional 2,100,000 shares, upsizing potential supply.
Company agreed to repurchase ~ $30,000,000 of shares from underwriters concurrently; repurchased shares to be treasury stock.
Company will not receive offering proceeds and expects to fund repurchase with cash on hand and borrowings under its ABL facility.
Book-running managers are Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank and J.P. Morgan; closing expected September 10, 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
